items.whyMechanical: One side is the numbered, owning state machine in the file whose entire subject is freshness (22.01.03, [DEEP]); the other is a restatement inside 22.01.01 that disclaims ownership of the classification in the same sentence that then emits its own thresholds. The CX-01 relationship is explicitly one-way derivation, so 22.01.01 has no standing to emit classification thresholds at all. 26h/50h and the state name `healthy` appear nowhere else in domain 22 — no downstream consumer depends on them, so this is orphaned drift, not a second authority.
items.summary: 22.01.01 emitted its own freshness thresholds (healthy < 26h, stale 26h–50h) and a state name `healthy` that is not in 22.01.03's five-state enum, contradicting the state machine it names as owner. Rewrote 22.01.01 to emit only the timestamp and a declared 24h cadence, deferring classification to 22.01.03, and renamed every `healthy` state token to `fresh`.
